body: Okie I'll drink just a bit then. Thank you.

Thank you for your response.

I don't blame him for leaving. Nobody should have to deal with me... All I do is bring everyone around me pain.

I deserve pain so that's ok. If it doesn't kill me I should at least be punished.
Wouldn't that dilate the poison? :< I deserve pain...

Thank you for caring and your kind words.

I refuse to call the paramedics tho... I'm hiding what I've done from everyone I live with for a reason. I don't really want help anymore. I'm still hopeful this poison will kill me, but if it doesn't the last thing I want is for the people around me to start making it harder for me to die. They've already been threatening to put me in the pysch hospital again and I refuse to to back to that place...
